order_events_from_status_check.name: order_events_from_status_check
order_events_from_status_check.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELED')

orders_canceled_by_check.name: orders_canceled_by_check
orders_canceled_by_check.value: canceled_by IS NULL OR canceled_by IN ('CUSTOMER', 'MERCHANT_USER', 'ADMIN', 'SYSTEM')

orders_cancel_reason_check.name: orders_cancel_reason_check
orders_cancel_reason_check.value: cancel_reason IS NULL OR cancel_reason IN ('CUSTOMER_REQUEST', 'MERCHANT_UNAVAILABLE', 'OUT_OF_STOCK', 'PAYMENT_ISSUE', 'OTHER')
